cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Analyst (FP&A) role at IMA Financial Group. The work you describe, rolling up the annual budget and quarterly forecast and owning monthly management reporting, is the work I have done every month since August 2023 as Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA.

At AMG I build the annual operating budget and the monthly forecasts for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. Each month I run budget-vs-actual variance analysis and put together KPI reports for ownership, with commentary on what moved and why. While doing that, I found gaps in our reporting and reconciliation and fixed them, which identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue. I also cut A/R aging by 10%. Your posting mentions data integrity and consistency, and that is exactly where I found my biggest wins.

Before AMG, I interned as a Financial Analyst at Northrop Grumman, where I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance, and internal controls, and tracked costs in SAP. That taught me to check a model's logic before trusting its output, a habit I bring to every forecast. I hold an M.A. in International Economics & Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk, and I work in advanced Excel, SQL, Python, and Tableau, so I can pull large data sets and build clean reporting on my own.

I am a U.S. citizen, need no sponsorship, and can start immediately. I would welcome the chance to talk through how I could support IMA's finance team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
